Generated answers for multi-choice QA and mathematical word problems
The models generate answers to natural language inference, mathematical reasoning, and multi-choice knowledge-based questions in 17 African languages and English/French.

changes_made.explanation: Changed answer from Yes to No because the paper primarily evaluates language understanding and reasoning, not natural language generation. Only mathematical reasoning involves minimal text generation (numerical answers). Removed NLG tasks that are actually classification/selection tasks. Normalized model names.

Removed COMET and AfriCOMET QE as they were used for translation quality assessment, not for evaluating the main NLG outputs. Kept Accuracy and Exact Match which are used for evaluating the model outputs.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The LLMs were the subjects being evaluated, not the evaluators.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluation was automated using metrics like accuracy and exact match.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about evaluating LLM capabilities in African languages for understanding and reasoning tasks, not natural language generation. The main contribution is the IrokoBench benchmark for cross-lingual evaluation. While there is some minimal generation (numerical answers for math problems), the focus is on comprehension and reasoning rather than text generation.
